context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on operations
purpose: Teach: 上回る/補給/含み/順次/終える/レギュラー/当店/常時

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 当店のレギュラー商品、常時棚に並べておけ。
lines.en: Keep the regular stock items on the shelves at all times.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. Delivered with the weight of experience—not commanding, but stating what he knows to be true. Slight pause before the final phrase, letting it land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。順次補給の体制、安定しています。
lines.en: Understood. Our replenishment cycle is running smoothly.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Crisp and professional without stiffness. The tone of someone fully present and taking the direction seriously. No over-explanation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 予測を上回る時こそ、慎重に。新案も含み、検討しろ。
lines.en: When demand exceeds what you've forecast, stay cautious. Think through new approaches before you act on them.
lines.style: Deliberate tempo. Each phrase gets space to settle. Warm but uncompromising—this is wisdom earned, not doctrine. A slight lean forward in attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。今期を終えるまでに、棚卸も完了させます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the full inventory count finished before the quarter closes.
lines.style: Assured and steady. No hedging. The voice of someone committing to something concrete. Direct eye-contact level of certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Brief nod in the voice. Warm approval with finality. The kind of quiet that says 'we're done here, and you've heard what matters.'
